## Definition of Done

The list is the same as in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md#definition-of-done).

- [ ] `cargo xtask check` passes.
- [ ] Each change in behaviour has tests.
- [ ] When a command or an option changes, each document that names it changes
      in the same commit.
- [ ] I read the source of each reference that I added or changed.
